d: Platinum white hair is very long and straight, falling past the waist with long bangs framing a mature, youthful face. The eyes are a piercing light blue with a sharp, focused expression. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a traditional-inspired ensemble consisting of a black and royal blue sleeveless dress with wide flowing sleeves, a high-waisted skirt with blue interior lining, and thigh-high black stockings. Signature details include a small gold crown with two pointed horns atop the head and a single long white tassel hanging from the hair.
